name: Sorry, Grandma!
source:
Help Little Red Riding Hood deliver pie to her sick grandma. Just a little warning! The journey might not be all smooth sailing. Will she make it? Who knows?

[From [url=https://cherriied-socks.itch.io/sorry-grandma]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帮助小红帽给她生病的奶奶送馅饼。只是一个小警告！旅程可能不会一帆风顺。她能成功吗？谁知道？

[来自[url=https://cherriied-socks.itch.io/sorry-grandma]itch.io[/url]]
